_note: City Edition check of 2026-09-27, approved by the owner in the conversation ('כן, לתקן'). The photo reviewers who paired the supplier's shorts with the store's jerseys flagged 18 basketball jerseys whose City Edition wording looked wrong (scratchpad xk/findings.json). sw-jerseys-152407516 was skipped: its flag is a note about a supplier misprint (MINNESTOA), not a title issue. Each of the other 17 was checked against the store photos and the supplier's Yupoo album (1464316803.x.yupoo.com/albums/<album>), and against the published NBA uniform sets by season (City, Icon, Association, Statement and Classic editions, confirmed with team and league sources: NBA.com, SportsLogos.net and the teams' announcements). Signals used: the wordmark and trim, the Nike swoosh versus the Jordan Jumpman (Statement Editions since 2020-21), the vintage NIKE logo (Classic Editions), the text above the jock tag, sponsor and season patches (#6 Bill Russell patch = 2022-23, NBA 75 logo = 2021-22). All 17 flags were right: 8 titles gained 'מהדורת עיר' and 9 lost it (the Timberwolves Statement also got its colour, שחור, as in the earlier scan's fixes). Only the City Edition words changed; years and colours stay as they were. For each fix the same words changed in the description's first line and in every photo's alt text (as in scan-fixes-2026-09-27.json); tags were re-derived with scripts/catalog/classify.mjs (only style:city-edition and the 'city edition' keyword moved; a run on the old titles reported 0 changes); sportwear.styles was set to ["city-edition"] on the 8 and deleted on the 9 that have no style left; en and ar title and body_html were rebuilt with scripts/catalog/translate-titles.py (0 unknown words) and registered with translationsRegister, and catalog/translations/older-products.json was updated. Nothing else changed: price, stock, status, handle, channels, complements and set tags are as before. Every Admin API call followed graphql_schema, validate_graphql_codeblocks, then execution.
